articles.title: Does anyone feature on more than two clubs' all-time top-10 scoring charts? | The Knowledge
articles.summary: Plus: the longest kit supply partnerships, more own goals (part II) and consecutive goalless draws. Mail us with all of your questions and answers. “Harry Kane is now Bayern’s seventh-highest scorer of all time, as well as being Tottenham’s highest scorer.
body: A trawl through the Knowledge archive reminded us that we have previously looked at players who are the record goalscorer for more than one club. This question is slightly different, as we’re focusing on goalscorers who are in the all-time top 10 for the most different clubs. There are dozens of players who appear for two clubs, including Sergio Ag üero (Atlético Madrid and Manchester City), Kenny Dalglish (Celtic and Liverpool), Jimmy Greaves (Chelsea and Tottenham), Lionel Messi (Barcelona and Inter Miami), Cristiano Ronaldo (Real Madrid and Al-Nassr) and Alan Shearer (Blackburn and Newcastle).

There’s one more worthy of mention. “ Harry Johnson is all-time top scorer for both Sheffield United and Mansfield,” writes Darren White. “He played for the Blades between 1919 and 1931, scoring 201 league goals. At the age of 32, he left for Mansfield, scoring 104 goals for them over three seasons. He didn’t play for anyone else, so he has the possibly unique record (for someone with more than one club) of being top scorer for every team he represented.”

articles.title: Too much Overlap? Gary Neville’s podcast empire knows no bounds
articles.summary: The Overlap has gone daily, with Steven Gerrard and Joe Hart among the latest additions to an ever-growing family. Viewed in 2026, Nathan Barley, Chris Morris’s 2005 sitcom, shows remarkable prescience about the last two decades of metropolitan life, from smartphone addiction and digital…
body: Setting aside the Gary Lineker Goalhanger empire, manspreading its centrist-dad agenda into issues way beyond guffaws with Micah Richards and Alan Shearer, there is Gary Neville to rule them all. Manchesterism’s second-most influential practitioner has been on heavy manoeuvres. Unlike Lineker’s productions, the Overlap’s output continues to stick largely to football; a rugby podcast was mothballed in February, though its cricket equivalent continues.

Having snatched Wayne Rooney from the BBC in the summer for a Manchester United-based two-hander with the YouTuber Mark Goldbridge, last week the Overlap went daily, extending the output to 4pm Monday to Friday. An online launch had Jamie Carragher baiting Goldbridge, real name Brent Di Cesare. The former policeman shunned a “no comment” approach during his interrogation, biting back during an exchange that had Neville choking on his Huel in laughter. Clipped up, the send button pressed, job done.

articles.title: Mikel Arteta has mastered the art of making substitutions at Arsenal
articles.summary: Arsenal have beaten Nottingham Forest, Sunderland and Leeds this season thanks to goals from players off the bench. By Opta Analyst. They say that once is an accident, twice is a coincidence and three times is a pattern.
body: With Arsenal labouring away at Nottingham Forest and the game drifting towards a goalless draw, Noni Madueke – introduced at half-time – won the game for the visitors, shimmying inside and striking a heavily deflected right-footed shot past Matz Sels. It was hardly a glamorous goal but it secured three valuable Premier League points for Arteta’s side.

It continued a recent trend. In each of their past three Premier League victories, Arsenal have won the game thanks to winning goals by substitutes. Bruno Guimarães provided the decisive contributions against Sunderland (2-0) and Leeds (2-1), before Madueke repeated the trick against Forest.

They are the only goals Arsenal’s substitutes have scored in the league this season. Five teams have scored more goals via their replacements, with Ipswich leading the way on five, but all of Arsenal’s substitute goals have been winners.

articles.title: Injury setbacks fuel Neill's hunger for Namibia tour
articles.summary: Ireland bowling all-rounder Jordan Neill feels past injury setbacks have made him "hungrier to come back harder" for the upcoming one-day series in Namibia.
body: Neill has been selected by new head coach Gary Wilson for the five-match series that begins on Thursday in Windhoek (08:30 BST).
The 21-year-old made his Ireland debut at the age of 19 in 2025 but suffered a number of injuries following his Test debut series in Bangladesh, leaving him sidelined for the bulk of this year.
He has since returned to action and was drafted by the Amsterdam Flames in the inaugural European T20 Premier League and is now keen to make up for lost time.
"There were definitely times where I was a bit down in the dumps," South Africa-born Neill said of his injury setbacks.

articles.title: Crystal Palace urged to retire bald eagle mascot
articles.summary: Animal rights group Peta is urging Crystal Palace to retire their bald eagle mascot, saying a "bright stadium filled with boisterous fans is no place for animals".
body: In a letter to Palace CEO Sharon Lacey, People for the Ethical Treatment of Animals (Peta) asked the Premier League club to stop using the eagle, named Phoenix, in pre-match displays at Selhurst Park and to never use live animal mascots again.

The London team, known as the Eagles since 1973, introduced a live eagle to matchdays in 2010. Kayla, who died in 2020, performed the role for 10 years and her replacement Phoenix made her debut against West Ham in August 2024.
Peta says birds can become "frightened, disoriented and panicked" in stadium environments, putting themselves and fans at risk.

Using them for displays and entertainment also denies the animals, who "would naturally avoid humans", the opportunity to engage with their natural instincts, leading to "frustration and stress", the group said.
points: Animal rights group Peta is urging Crystal Palace to retire their bald eagle mascot, saying a "bright stadium filled with boisterous fans is no place for animals".

articles.title: Key questions as Farrell set to name Ireland squad
articles.summary: A look at some of the key questions facing Ireland head coach Andy Farrell as he prepares to name his Nations Championship squad on Wednesday.
body: Ireland head coach Andy Farrell's latest squad selection this week is likely to stir debate about how his team are shaping up with less than a year to go until the 2027 Rugby World Cup.

On Wednesday, Farrell will reveal his panel for next month's Nations Championship home leg, which includes home matches against Argentina, Fiji and back-to-back world champions South Africa before the finals weekend at Twickenham.
Ireland opened their Nations Championship campaign with wins over Australia and Japan before a 40-21 loss to New Zealand in Auckland.
After November, the Six Nations will be Farrell's only extended period of competitive action with his squad before they travel to Australia for the showpiece tournament.

articles.summary: Macs Page has a "huge future" with Wales despite being left out of Steve Tandy's Nations Championship squad, according to former Dragons and Ospreys boss Lyn Jones. Wing Page, 21, had been tipped for a call-up for the November Tests having been in fine form for Scarlets.
body: But Wales head coach Tandy instead opted to recall Rio Dyer and Gabriel Hamer-Webb alongside Josh Adams, Ellis Mee, Blair Murray, Tom Rogers and Louis Rees-Zammit.
Tandy's squad features three uncapped players – prop Rhys Barratt, centre Aneurin Owen and scrum-half Che Hope – and Jones feels Page's age may have counted against him.
"Experience is something that has been lacking from the Welsh squad," Jones told BBC Radio Wales Breakfast.
"It's another young, uncapped player and he (Tandy) is probably a little bit afraid to introduce Macs just at the moment, but he has a huge, huge future for Wales. That is for certain."

articles.title: Horner reveals Red Bull decision that helped Mercedes sign Hamilton
articles.summary: Christian Horner has revealed he helped Mercedes sign Lewis Hamilton after holding early discussions with the British driver's management to join Red Bull.
body: Hamilton left McLaren to join Mercedes at the start of 2013 but in Horner's new book, 'Drive ', which will be on sale from this Thursday, he says Hamilton showed interest to join Red Bull.
Senior figures at Red Bull, including co-owner Dietrich Mateschitz, were not keen on the move that would have seen Hamilton replace Mark Webber and become Sebastian Vettel's team-mate from 2013.
Vettel had won the last three drivers' titles at the time and Horner explained the situation on Sky Sports' The F1 Show Podcast.
"As a team principal, it's your job to understand what is the driver market. Naturally, when you've got the fastest car, the best drivers want to drive in the best cars," said Horner.

articles.title: FireKeepers poker championship tops $2.3M prize pool
articles.summary: FireKeepers Casino Hotel's Mid-States Poker Tour (MSPT) Spade Poker Championship drew 2,442 entries and built a $2,367,240 prize pool, with MSPT Hall of Famer Umut Ozturk winning the tournament and earning $280,290. The six-day poker series was held Oct.
body: The six-day poker series was held Oct. 13-18 at FireKeepers Casino Hotel in Battle Creek, according to a community announcement. The $1,110 buy-in Main Event exceeded its $1 million guaranteed prize pool by more than $1.36 million.

Ozturk claimed his third Major Series of Poker: The Tour title after advancing through one of the largest fields on the MSPT schedule. The championship payout represented the largest tournament score of his career. Ozturk and runner-up Greg Wiggins each received $280,290 after agreeing to an even chop during heads-up play.
With three players remaining, Ozturk eliminated Gian Bencivenga when his suited ace held against Bencivenga's suited king-queen. Bencivenga finished third and earned $164,811.

The Main Event featured three starting flights from Oct. 15-17 before Day 2 play on Oct. 18. Players began with 30,000 chips and competed in 40-minute blind levels. The tournament awarded 1.5 times the standard Player of the Year points.

articles.title: Surging Monmouth football aims to avoid upset at Hampton homecoming | preview
articles.summary: Monmouth football needs to avoid any letdowns ahead of big games against Bryant and Campbell. First, the Hawks must take care of business vs. Hampton.
body: WEST LONG BRANCH -- Late October is the peak of the midseason grind. The playoffs are not quite in sight, and any attempt to peer ahead could derail the current journey. Monmouth football learned that lesson the hard way last year, but this year's group is uniquely equipped to embrace the grit in the make-or-break middle stretch of an arduous campaign.

The FCS No. 18 Hawks need to avoid any let downs as two big conference matchups against Bryant and Campbell loom on the horizon and could decide the CAA champion. First, they must go on the road in a notoriously loud environment this Saturday and take care of business against 1-6 Hampton.

The grind in football is eternal and the growth for many doesn't always fortuitously arrive under the spotlight. But the Hawks' win over New Hampshire this past week was that moment for two players that have embraced the process without the guarantee of a payoff.

articles.title: NBA season tips off as Detroit stage epic 22-point comeback to defeat Celtics
articles.summary: Detriot Pistons staged an epic 23-0 run in the fourth quarter as they overcame a 22-point deficit - the largest come-from-behind win against the Boston Celtics in the last 30 seasons - to seal a stunning 121-113 win.
body: Javonte Green scored 19 points after not playing in the first half and Cade Cunningham finished with 22 points and eight assists, helping the Pistons to victory as the NBA season tipped off in style on Tuesday.

Paul George scored 38 points, the most by a Celtic in his debut. The nine-time All-Star, in his 17th season, showed he's still got it in his first game with Boston since it acquired him from Philadelphia in exchange for 2024 NBA Finals MVP Jaylen Brown.
Jayson Tatum, a six-time All-Star, was off his game, missing 17 of 23 shots and had 13 points and 11 assists.
His lack of hustle on defense allowed Green to take his time for a fifth 3-pointer that gave the Pistons a 13-point lead with 3:33 left.

articles.title: Have set-piece kings Arsenal really become set-piece strugglers?
articles.summary: Arsenal scored a Premier League-high 25 non-penalty set-piece goals on their way to winning the title last season. But have 'Set-piece FC' lost their not-so-secret edge?
body: Seven games into the new campaign, the Gunners are one of only four sides, along with Liverpool, Manchester United and Nottingham Forest, yet to score a non-penalty set-piece goal.
Arsenal's total last season included a record 19 from corners and made it five straight Premier League seasons in which they have scored at least 15 non-penalty set-piece goals.
The improvement coincided with addition of Nicolas Jover to their backroom staff in 2021. The set-piece coach has been described as a "genius" and remains an active presence on the touchline.
So why have the set-piece goals dried up? Arsenal manager Mikel Arteta put it down to luck in comments made earlier this month.
